extraction_notes: SI Figures S5-S8 contain catalytic CO2 hydrogenation performance and were digitised. SI Figure S11 was not extracted because it is a TPSR experiment with CO/H2/N2 feed rather than CO2 hydrogenation performance. Other SI figures are characterisation, DFT, or tabulated literature data and were skipped. All plotted y-values are approximate digitised values.
